Annuity revenues grew 14.7% YoY, supporting predictable growth.

guidance.statement: Management expects full-year EBITDA margin of 23-25%, with Q1 being the lowest quarter.
Management expects to maintain double-digit revenue growth in FY27, improving on last year's growth rate.
Management expects to recover the Q1 implementation revenue shortfall of ~₹12 Cr in Q2 and Q3.

operating_notes.text: Annuity revenues comprise ATS/AMC, Cloud/Subscription License revenue streams and Support revenues, contributing 62% to FY26 revenue.
US geography revenue grew 17% YoY and APAC revenue grew 14% YoY in FY26.
Annuity revenues contributed 62% to FY26 revenue, amounting to ₹968 crores.
Newgen Software Technologies (UK) Limited secured a 3.5-year software licenses, cloud services, and implementation contract worth GBP 1.13 million (₹14.47 Cr).
USA geography revenue grew 27% YoY to ₹91.51 Cr in Q1FY27, the fastest of the four regions.
Q1FY27 other income of ₹36.27 Cr equalled about 44% of pre-tax profit of ₹82.12 Cr.
Q1FY27 annuity revenue was approximately ₹254 Cr, 14% YoY growth, with SaaS and license subscription at approximately ₹60 Cr, up 40% YoY.
Q1FY27 geography mix: EMEA approximately ₹114 Cr, India approximately ₹96 Cr, USA approximately ₹92 Cr (up 27% YoY), APAC approximately ₹56 Cr (up 12% YoY).
Q1FY27 vertical mix: banking and financial services approximately ₹225 Cr (up 5% YoY), insurance and healthcare approximately ₹79 Cr (up 58% YoY).

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹452.67 Cr (+5.3% YoY), net profit ₹106.3 Cr (-1.9% YoY).
Newgen Software reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹452.7 Cr and FY26 PAT of ₹334.3 Cr, supported by annuity growth.
Newgen Software reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,574 Cr and PAT of ₹334 Cr (excl. exceptional items).
Newgen Software Technologies Limited shared the audio recording of its 30th April 2026 conference call for Q4FY26 & FY26 results on its website.
Newgen Software reported FY26 revenue of ₹1,574 Cr and PAT of ₹301 Cr, with annuity revenue reaching 62% of total sales.
Newgen Software's UK subsidiary secured a 3.5-year enterprise content management order worth ₹14.47 Cr on May 6, 2026.
T.S. Varadarajan, promoter of Newgen Software Technologies Limited, declared no new encumbrances on equity shares for FY2026 on 06.04.2026.
Newgen reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹356.68 Cr and PAT of ₹62.82 Cr; helped by ₹36.27 Cr other income; and recommended a ₹6.00 per share FY26 dividend.
Newgen reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹356.68 Cr and PAT of ₹62.82 Cr; EBITDA margin expanded to 15.7% from 14.0% YoY.

Newgen's Q1FY27 earnings call reported revenue of ₹357 Cr (+11% YoY), EBITDA margin of 15.7%, and PAT of ₹63 Cr (+26% YoY), with management guiding to 23-25% full-year EBITDA margin and announcing Tarun Nandwani as CEO effective August 1, 2026.
Newgen Software Technologies Ltd’s 34th AGM held on 24th July 2026 via VC, chaired by T.S. Varadarajan with 178 members present.
On 2026-09-03, CRISIL reaffirmed the short-term rating A1 for ₹125 Cr bank facilities of Newgen Software, enhanced from ₹96 Cr, valid till 31-Mar-2027.

On 2026-09-21 Newgen executed a US$1,791,140 (₹17.14 Cr) agreement with a Qatar-based customer for its regulatory reporting and compliance platform, covering licence, implementation and three years of support.

On 28 Sep 2026, Newgen Software Inc., the US material subsidiary, executed a ₹52.55 Cr (US$ 5.475 million) three-year agreement with a US health insurer for NewgenONE CAG solution licence, implementation, cloud hosting and support.

On 12 October 2026, Newgen Software disclosed the superannuation retirement of Mr. Surender Jeet Raj, EVP-Global Business Strategy and HR and a designated Key Managerial Personnel, effective close of business that day.
On 2026-10-16, Newgen Software's UK subsidiary won a GBP £1.63M (₹20.51 Cr) order from Just Retirement Management Services Limited for a document management system.

On 16 October 2026, Newgen Software Technologies (UK) Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, executed a GBP £1.63M (₹20.51 Cr) 3.5-year agreement with Just Retirement Management Services Limited, UK, for OmniDocs and OmniOMS document management, cloud hosting, implementation and support.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹422.24 Cr (+5.4% YoY), net profit ₹86.88 Cr (+6.3% YoY).
On 23 October 2026, Newgen Software reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹422.2 Cr (up 5.4% YoY) and PAT of ₹86.9 Cr, driven by a recovery in EMEA and 10 new AI-led deal wins.
On 23 October 2026, Newgen Software reported the continuing unavailability of Chairman & MD Diwakar Nigam due to indisposition.
